description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Smarty_Resource_Extendsall' that extends the internal resource class for Smarty templates. It implements methods to populate source metadata by traversing template directories and inheriting templates with the same name, and overrides timestamp checking behavior.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource_Extendsall
classes.description: A Smarty resource class that extends all templates by traversing template directories and inheriting templates with the same name.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the source object with metadata from the resource by walking through template directories and inheriting template information.

methods.name: checkTimestamps
methods.description: Overrides to disable timestamp checks; individual source components are checked instead.
